rules.name: Citizens reported this project
rules.verify: Open the project on transparency.dpwh.gov.ph and read the citizen reports and photos.

rules.name: Marked completed, progress below 100%
rules.verify: Compare the status and progress on the portal with the project's documents and photos.

rules.name: Reported 100% done but still listed as on-going
rules.verify: Usually a status update that has not been entered yet. Check the portal for a newer status.

rules.name: Same description 3+ times in one office
rules.verify: Check whether these are separate phases or sections of one road, or a project listed more than once.

rules.name: One contractor holds half an office's yearly budget
rules.verify: Check the contractor's SEC General Information Sheet, and whether the contracts were competitively bid.

rules.name: No coordinates on a large project
rules.verify: Ask DPWH for the project location through eFOI so it can be inspected.
